deferral_rationale: Reconciler r1 severity downgrade BLOCKER->CONCERN per workflow.yaml § concerns_protocol.reconciler_special_case. Finding verified REAL (verify_report.py:1483 consumes the segment's FIRST 8-40 hex run as the pin before label derivation, so a hex-run-bearing phase slug — legal under provenance.py:66 _PHASE_IDENTITY_RE — cannot use the b3 exact channel) but NON-BLOCKING: (1) the first-hex-run consumption is pre-existing #2191 code (origin/main verify_report.py:1436) inherited byte-identically — for such slugs behavior degrades to exactly main's token path, never a new mis-pair; (2) b3 is WARN-only in both modes and unresolved segments are aggregate-visible in the detail line (:1552-1553); (3) no realized phase name in the repo carries an 8+-hex run (stage2-upload, bank, anchors, grid, margin, phase2, P1_train, phase0_gates); (4) the silent-bypass domain is narrower than the finding stated — for slugs with a distinctive non-hex remainder (run-deadbeef) the token path still resolves via phase-token overlap (_card_side_tokens splits phase on -/_), so a wrong pin still draws the token-variant mispair WARN; only all-hex or ambiguous-remainder slugs skip silently; (5) b1 independently FAILs (generation mode) any card commit never cited in the report. Disposition: address opportunistically — Codex's unique-hex-candidate disambiguation sketch, or a documented slug-shape caveat + test; does not warrant a revision round.
